change: Use installed macOS application icons instead of substitute SF Symbols in the Mac app picker.
loading: On row appearance; only the rendered thumbnail is retained by the view. No persistent icon cache, additional timer or network request.
performance: No whole-process profile taken. Pixel-buffer size excludes Cocoa overhead, temporary rendering and macOS icon caching.
privacy: No third-party icon assets or per-user state added to the public repository.
